Rct3pp.PatrolCopy: Give area to all in this job
Rct3pp.PatrolUncovered: Paths no one in this job patrols:
Rct3pp.KeysTip: Click, then press the keys: F1 to F12, Escape, Enter, Tab, Page Up, Page Down or Insert, with Ctrl or Shift if wanted, or Ctrl with a letter or digit. Escape alone keeps the keys.
Rct3pp.CloudsHelp: Clouds drift across the sky above the park.
Rct3pp.SkyHelp: The sky shows the colours of the time of day, with the sun, the moon and the stars.
Rct3pp.MountainsHelp: Hills and mountains stand far beyond the edges of the park.
Rct3pp.BlendShadowsHelp: Shadows move smoothly as the sun crosses the sky, rather than in small steps. Costs a little more to draw.
Rct3pp.SurfaceDetailHelp: Grain gives textures fine detail up close, where they would look blurred, at almost no cost. Grain and relief also makes height from the light and dark of each texture, so brick, rock and paths catch the sun near the camera; it costs more to draw and takes effect when a park is loaded.
Rct3pp.DetailBlendBandHelp: How long the stretch is over which scenery blends from one level of detail to the next as the camera moves.
Rct3pp.AllItemsShown: All shown: the park does not say which are available

Paths.PickStart: Click the ground to start a path
Paths.NotOwned: The park does not own this land
Paths.OffMap: Off the edge of the park
Paths.Underground: The path would go into the ground; turn on cutting to dig it in
Paths.Occupied: Another path is in the way
Paths.RouteHelp: Route: point at a tile and the path finds its own way there from the arrow
